result.summary: Updates `-acceptnonstdtxn=1` (available only on test networks) to skip standard non-mandatory script verification flags during mempool acceptance, checking only consensus script flags instead. It also replaces a heuristic flag-mask check in `CheckInputScripts` with an explicit enum parameter separating block validation from mempool validation, and introduces compile-time assertions to ensure standard verify flags subsume consensus flags.
result.problem: On test networks, configuring a node with `-acceptnonstdtxn=1` admits transactions with non-standard formats or output scripts into the mempool, but policy script verification still unconditionally enforced `STANDARD_SCRIPT_VERIFY_FLAGS`. As a result, transactions testing soft-fork upgrades or non-mandatory script rules (such as `OP_SUCCESS`, `OP_NOPx`, or uncompressed keys in SegWit) were rejected from testnet mempools.
evidence: PR description: "This PR changes `-acceptnonstdtxn=1` so that it also skips the non-mandatory script checks, allowing txs that (eg) use OP_NOPx or OP_SUCCESS into the mempool. This remains only available on test nets."
result.scope_notes: Touches `validation.cpp` and adds a `consteval` helper (`ConsensusScriptVerifyFlags`) to enforce at compile time that consensus flag subsets match `MANDATORY_SCRIPT_VERIFY_FLAGS`.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased with updated test scripts and minor refactoring of the compile-time flag assertions; core approach is unchanged.
result.card: Allows transactions violating non-mandatory script standardness rules (such as OP_NOPx or OP_SUCCESS) to enter the mempool when running with `-acceptnonstdtxn=1` on test networks. Previously, testnet nodes with `-acceptnonstdtxn=1` accepted non-standard transaction structures but still rejected transactions that triggered non-mandatory script verification flags. The change also replaces a heuristic flag check in `CheckInputScripts` with an explicit block-versus-mempool enum and adds compile-time validation for consensus script flags.

risk.why: Alters the signature and error-classification logic of `CheckInputScripts` used during both block connection and mempool acceptance, though policy flag relaxation is restricted to test networks with `-acceptnonstdtxn=1`.
